title: HVTracker: Streamlit is now #1 on the leaderboard
body:
Hi Streamlit team,

We just added Streamlit to HVTracker, and in our latest public snapshot dated June 2, 2026, Streamlit is ranked #1 overall on the HVTracker leaderboard and #1 in UI & App Builders.

Profile: https://hvtracker.net/agents/streamlit/
Leaderboard: https://hvtracker.net/

Current public signals on the profile include:
- HVTrust score: 94.1
- Evidence grade: A

If you’d like, please add your HVTracker badge to the repo README so users can see the live trust profile directly from the project page.

Badge markdown:
[![HVTrust](https://hvtracker.net/badge/streamlit.svg)](https://hvtracker.net/agents/streamlit/)
[![Evidence Grade](https://hvtracker.net/badge/streamlit-grade.svg)](https://hvtracker.net/agents/streamlit/)

Badge guide: https://hvtracker.net/badges/

Thanks for building and maintaining Streamlit.

comments.body: Thanks for listing 👍  Will check with the team if we want to add the badges
